lead: You need Docker installed for lesson 6; only lessons 6 and 7 require Docker. Here, caixa-do-agente works on a copy of the project. Make a small change without a key, read the patch, and decide whether to apply it. You’ll also learn how to let agents work in a copy, in an optional example that isn’t run in this course.
objetivo: Create and read a patch without a key, apply the reviewed change to the project, and undo it.

aprende.t: Review the patch and apply it consciously
Read the auditor’s score without confusing it with the model’s score

hero_alt: Editorial photo representing caixa-do-agente in your project.

secoes.sub: The original only changes when you apply the patch you read or confirm a new run with --aplicar.

nos.detalhe: The script copies the project to a temporary folder, leaving .env, .pem keys, and ~/.ssh out. The agent can see any other file in the copy.
A command or agent works on the copy, with memory, CPU, and time limits. A cloud agent needs --rede and its key; anything in the copy could be sent over the network.
The kit counts changes, saves a .patch (changes file), and deletes the container and copy.
To bring over exactly what you read, use patch -p1 in the project. --aplicar runs everything again, saves another patch, and asks before copying; with an agent, the new run may change the result.

secoes.legenda: Click each part to see what it does.

secoes.sub: Click each step to see what to do.

texto: The create → run → destroy flow uses a copy: .env, .pem keys, and ~/.ssh stay out. The Docker image is the box’s mold; without --aplicar, the original stays intact. There are memory, CPU, and time limits.

With --rede, the box gets network access. With --env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, only that key goes in. The optional command with an agent uses your key and may send the copy’s contents to the agent service; it wasn’t run in this course. --dangerously-skip-permissions turns off the agent’s internal questions in the copy. Check the patch before applying it.
On macOS, caixa.sh also needs the timeout command: install coreutils with brew install coreutils, as described in the kit’s README.

A patch is a text file with the changes. The .patch file goes in the folder where you ran caixa.sh, or in the folder specified by --patch PASTA. Read it with less (press q to exit) before applying it. In patch -p1, -p1 removes the first part of the path, “before/” or “work/”, so it matches the file in your folder. Use the exact name shown by the box.
For a new file, the before/ line in the patch header may show 1969; it represents the file not existing before the run.

The auditor checks Claude Code, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness installed on the computer, along with the project. A harness is the program that runs model commands; a sandbox limits what it can access. If none of these programs are installed, the score will be low, and that’s normal; it doesn’t measure the AI’s intelligence.

The first exercise uses ~/intelecto-v2 and the public python:3.12-slim image; it doesn’t need a key or cloud agent. The second runs tests in an image prepared with pytest, the Python testing program. The project’s README documents 67 tests passed and 1 skipped in an earlier run; check your own output.

secoes.titulo: Create, read, and apply a patch without a key
secoes.sub: Docker from lesson 6 should already be working. Start in your home folder and use the full path to caixa.sh; the patch will be saved in ~. Replace AAAAMMDD-HHMMSS with the name printed by the box.

secoes.titulo: What the optional agent example does
paragrafos: This example from the caixa-do-agente README was not run in this course. It uses your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and sends a copy of the project over the network to the agent service. This may use your service subscription or credits.

./caixa.sh ~/meu-projeto copies that project; --rede allows internet access; --env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY puts only that key in the sandbox. After --, npx -y @anthropic-ai/claude-code -p "run the tests" starts the agent with that request; --dangerously-skip-permissions removes the agent's internal prompts in the copy. The sandbox creates a patch for you to review before applying it to the original.

secoes.sub: Follow the steps in order and check each one only after you’ve confirmed the result.

exercicios.titulo: Make the change and return it to the original
exercicios.texto: In your home folder, run the command without a key, using the python:3.12-slim image and ~/caixa-do-agente/caixa.sh. Copy the printed patch name. Open that file with less and press q to exit; go to ~/intelecto-v2, apply it with patch -p1, check with cat nota.txt, and undo it with rm nota.txt.
exercicios.pronto: The patch you read contains +teste; patch prints “patching file nota.txt”; cat shows “teste”; after rm, the test note is no longer in the original.

exercicios.titulo: Run the tests in another sandbox
exercicios.texto: In ~/intelecto-v2, create the intelecto-v2-testes image with docker build. Then, in ~/caixa-do-agente, run caixa.sh with that image and python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider. The kit's bash testes/teste.sh suite is optional.
exercicios.pronto: Pytest shows your test summary, and the sandbox reports how many files changed; compare it with the documented measurement without expecting the same numbers.

secoes.sub: Choose before opening the explanation. If you get it wrong, use the link to review.

perguntas.p: What is the “mockup” in this lesson?
opcoes: The original project, open for the AI to edit
perguntas.explica: The script creates a copy without the secret files. The original only receives the patch you read with patch -p1, or a new run confirmed with --aplicar.

perguntas.p: How do you apply exactly the changes you reviewed to the original?
opcoes: Run --aplicar without reviewing the new run
Use patch -p1 with the reviewed file
Ask the agent for another response
perguntas.explica: After you read the file, patch -p1 applies that exact patch. -p1 removes “antes/” or “trabalho/” from the path; --aplicar starts a new run.

perguntas.p: What does the auditor's note measure?
opcoes: The agents' environment and the project
The quality of the Telegram response
perguntas.explica: The auditor checks the installed coding agent environment and the project. Without Claude Code, Codex, or DeepSeek Harness, a low score is expected.

itens.texto: The box works in a copy without .env or keys and starts without network access. With --rede, the copy’s contents can be sent; resources remain limited.
The patch shows changes. patch -p1 applies the file you read; --aplicar starts another round and asks before copying.
The score depends on the agent programs installed on your computer, not the model’s intelligence.
